# Your Friendly Neighborhood BGSA {#sec-bgsa}

The Biostatistics Graduate Student Association is a registered club at Vanderbilt and also a student chapter of the ASA! 

Please see the (again, unofficial) [BGSA website](https://vandybgsa.github.io/) or our official [Anchorlink](https://anchorlink.vanderbilt.edu/organization/Biostatistics) page for more details about events we run, such as weekly journal club and the annual department Lightning Talks.
